arguments.content:
DISCHARGE INSTRUCTIONS - AISHA RAHMAN

WARFARIN (5mg daily):
Take at the same time each day. Maintain INR target 2.0-3.0. Schedule INR checks every 3-5 days initially, then weekly. Bleeding precautions: use soft toothbrush, electric razor; avoid NSAIDs; report unusual bruising, bleeding, or black stools. Keep vitamin K intake consistent.

ALENDRONATE (70mg weekly):
Take once weekly on the same day, first thing in morning with 8 oz plain water only. Remain upright for 30 minutes after taking. Do not take with food, milk, or coffee. With CKD stage 3a (eGFR 48), kidney function will be monitored every 3-6 months.

METOPROLOL (50mg twice daily):
Take morning and evening. Do not skip doses. Rise slowly from sitting/lying positions to prevent dizziness.

PAIN/CONSTIPATION MANAGEMENT:
Acetaminophen 325mg every 6 hours as needed (max 3,000mg daily). Senna 8.6mg at bedtime as needed for constipation. Stay hydrated and eat fiber-rich foods.

HIP FRACTURE POST-OP CARE:
Follow weight-bearing restrictions per orthopedic surgeon. Use walker/assistive device as instructed. Elevate leg to reduce swelling. Watch incision for infection signs (redness, drainage, fever). Perform PT exercises.

CKD STAGE 3A PRECAUTIONS:
Stay well hydrated. Monitor blood pressure. Avoid nephrotoxic medications. Follow-up with nephrology as scheduled.

FOLLOW-UP APPOINTMENTS:
Orthopedics (1-2 weeks), Cardiology (1 week for warfarin), Nephrology (4 weeks), Primary Care (2 weeks). Home Health Nursing will contact within 24 hours.

HOME HEALTH SERVICES:
Physical therapy 2-3 times weekly, occupational therapy as needed, nursing visits for wound care and medication management.

Stay well hydrated. Monitor blood pressure. Avoid nephrotoxic medications. Follow-up with nephrology as scheduled.
